dedupe_keys.name: glasgow 3d city models tree canopy and terrain from airborne lidar urban big data centre

description: This is a large-scale 3D city model of Glasgow with terrain, tree canopy and building products derived from high-density airborne LiDAR acquired in 2020 and 2021 on behalf of Glasgow City Council. It is produced by the Urban Big Data Centre at the University of Glasgow; the Zenodo versions are by Qiaosi Li and Qunshan Zhao, with Glasgow City Council and university co-authors on version 4 (10 March 2025), and the UBDC catalogue lists it with a DataCite DOI from 2024. Terrain products are 0.5-metre digital terrain, surface and normalised surface models; tree products are canopy height models and treetop points. Buildings are footprint polygons with height attributes and LoD1 and LoD2 models, the latter built with the City3D tool, with an error table for LoD2 reconstruction. Coverage is Glasgow City, in 5 by 5 kilometre tiles. Access: version 4 on Zenodo for buildings (OBJ, shapefile and CityJSON with attributes) and version 1 for terrain and trees, which are the latest for those products. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the version 1 building data are legacy, and a few LoD2 models are flagged as problematic. Simulation uses: building heights and tree canopy for urban heat, flood exposure, solar and digital twin models. Related records: 3DBAG and GlobalBuildingAtlas.
